description: Most coding agents grep and glob raw source into LLM's context window and hope the model is smart. Benzi compiles your codebase into a map of calls, data flow, control flow and class hierarchy first, then reads, explains, runs, edits and verifies from it. The Benzi compiler also works as an MCP server.
summary: Benzi is code intelligence infrastructure for AI models.  Claude Code greps; Cursor embeds; Aider maps signatures; Benzi resolves — and answers in O(1). Every language runs its own tree-sitter grammar into the same query map.
